علی ہے بولتا قرآن سنو\"\"\",
\"\"\"نبی کو عظمت پہ پہرا دینا
ہمیں بابا نے سکھایا
نبی کا دشمن ہے اپنا دشمن

علی ہے بولتا قرآن سنو\"\"\",
]

            import re

p.write_text('---' + header + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + '\\n'.join('  ' + line if line else '' for line in roman_numbered) + '\\n---\\n\\n' + source + '\\n')

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu-script body and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified verse-by-verse alignment across the opening and all five stanzas, including every repeated refrain. Updated the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, and removed `noUrdu`.

Two uncertain Roman readings were rendered as `حزن اللہ` for “Huznullah” and `دستِ خدا` for “dast r qudaa.”
